_comment: Example manifest for experiments/creative_ranking_videos_*. Copy to data/padsplit_videos.json with real entries. Flat format shown; video_path is relative to this file's directory (absolute paths also fine). Metrics: impressions+clicks derive smoothed CTR; conversions derives conversion_rate; or provide any precomputed field and pass --metric <name>. Optional fields: campaign (pairs are built within the same campaign so audiences match), brand, platform. A {"train": [...], "test": [...]} pair format mirroring data/tweet_pairs.json is also accepted.
